question: Under which Viceroy was the Permanent Settlement of Bengal in 1793 introduced?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charles Cornwallis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Charles Cornwallis was the Governor-General of India from 1786 to 1793.
 
• He introduced the Permanent Settlement in 1793, which is also known as the Zamindari System.
 
• The Permanent Settlement created a new class of landlords with hereditary rights on land.
